description: This file contains implementation related to reflog expiration management, including configuration parsing, expiration policies, reference handling, and cleanup routines in a version control system (likely Git).

methods.name: struct:reflog_expire_entry_option * find_cfg_ent(struct reflog_expire_options * opts,const char * pattern,size_t len)
methods.description: Finds or creates a reflog expiration entry matching a pattern within options.

methods.name: int reflog_expire_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Parses configuration settings to set expiration options for reflog entries.

methods.name: void reflog_clear_expire_config(struct reflog_expire_options * opts)
methods.description: Clears all configured expiration entries from options.

methods.name: void reflog_expire_options_set_refname(struct reflog_expire_options * cb,const char * ref)
methods.description: Sets expiration parameters based on a reference name pattern.

methods.name: int tree_is_complete(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a tree object and all its entries are fully available and complete.

methods.name: int commit_is_complete(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Determines whether a commit object and its ancestry are fully available.

methods.name: int keep_entry(struct commit ** it,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a commit pointed to by an object id exists and is complete.

methods.name: void mark_reachable(struct expire_reflog_policy_cb * cb)
methods.description: Marks commits reachable from a set of starting points as reachable, within the provided callback context.

methods.name: int is_unreachable(struct expire_reflog_policy_cb * cb,struct commit * commit,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Tests if a commit is unreachable based on current reachability marks.

methods.name: int should_expire_reflog_ent(struct object_id * ooid,struct object_id * noid,const char * email UNUSED,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz UNUSED,const char * message UNUSED,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Determines if a reflog entry should be considered expired based on timestamp and reachability.

methods.name: int should_expire_reflog_ent_verbose(struct object_id * ooid,struct object_id * noid,const char * email,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz,const char * message,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Provides verbose output and checks for reflog expiration.

methods.name: int push_tip_to_list(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Adds the tip commits from a reference to a list for further processing.

methods.name: int is_head(const char * refname)
methods.description: Checks if a given refname corresponds to the current HEAD.

methods.name: void reflog_expiry_prepare(const char * refname,const struct object_id * oid,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Prepares the state for reflog expiration based on the reference name and object id.

methods.name: void reflog_expiry_cleanup(void * cb_data)
methods.description: Cleans up the state after reflog expiration process.

methods.name: int count_reflog_ent(const char * refname UNUSED,struct object_id * ooid UNUSED,struct object_id * noid UNUSED,const char * email UNUSED,timestamp_t timestamp,int tz UNUSED,const char * message UNUSED,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Counts reflog entries for a particular ref, updating expiration counters.

methods.name: int reflog_delete(const char * rev,enum expire_reflog_flags flags,int verbose)
methods.description: Deletes reflog entries for a specific ref according to expiration policies, with verbose logging option.
